There is currently no application; this is an ordered planning packet. Creator completes payment legal/bank/MFA details personally. Configure test mode GBP and controlled email domain/recipient. Store PAYMENT_SECRET, PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, EMAIL_API_KEY, EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET in backend sandbox store. Register webhook URLs only after endpoint target exists; never real customer sends or money.

Applicable common rules: server owns prices/availability/state; GBP integer pence, UTC instants plus Europe/London display and date semantics; role/ownership checked on every action; Idempotency-Key and expected_version protect repeated/stale mutations; pending external result is not success/failure. No network calls under database locks. Detailed requirements and tests below remain mandatory even if linked files change.

References: docs/design/contracts.md K04 K05 K08; docs/design/screens.md; docs/design/coverage.md; relevant docs/design/features/ packet; docs/planning/DELIVERY.md; SETUP.md. These are local unpushed planning artifacts; obtain this checkout's exact fingerprinted packet before execution.

## To dos

T1. Review current prerequisites and the concrete options/rules in Context; collect missing evidence (AC1).
T2. Perform only the Creator action described, recording settings/decision versions and safe nonsecret evidence (AC1–AC3).
T3. Check the acceptance examples, record remaining blockers and hand the approved output to dependent Agent tickets (AC3, AC4).

## Not to dos

Do not implement unrelated cleanup, register candidate alternatives, expose credentials, publish releases or deploy without the separate scoped authorization. Planning publication does not authorize application execution now. Do not mark Done without the board's acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1. Selected payment test account and event/API version configuration recorded; dependent agent can run GBP capture and full/partial refund sandbox checks.
AC2. Selected sender domain verified via exact provider DNS; From/Reply-To and controlled recipient recorded.
AC3. Webhook endpoint reachability waits on deployed sandbox endpoint; account provisioning evidence and later endpoint verification are separate.
AC4. Required acceptance evidence is tied to exact input/output revision, checked by the appropriate reviewer/Creator and recorded on Trello. For implementation include relevant tests, all related PRs, required review/checks, merge and main CI; authorized release/deployment/smoke only when separately in scope.

Verification: inspect the concrete decision/configuration and nonsecret evidence against AC1–AC3. No forced software red/green cycle for human work. Account creation follows accepted-provider gate; no secret values in Trello.

Publication snapshot of the independently reviewed planning packet. Trello is the live execution record; application work has not started.
